why: Step 288 closed Wikipedia attention at its mapping gate (59.2% vs 60%) before any return was measured. The owner asked whether the news-type signals were tested properly; this one was not. This is a NEW experiment on the 357 issuers that were mapped, not a reversal of Step 288's gate: the sample is the mapped subset of the narrow 603-issuer universe and is declared as such -- it over-represents larger, better-known names.
data: data/wikipedia_attention_v1/views (daily user pageviews, 2015-07 to 2026-09), summed to weeks ending Friday; a week's views are usable at that Friday's close

signals.W1_attention_surge: log(mean weekly views over the last 4 weeks + 1) - log(mean over the prior 26 weeks + 1)

measurement.decisions: every 4 weeks, forward window from the next weekly close
measurement.measures: rank IC, decile spread, monotonicity, block bootstrap, both halves
